# LaSalle Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for LaSalle. Air-conditioning repair covers central air conditioners and ductless systems, including cooling, electrical-control, refrigerant-circuit, airflow, and condensate faults.

Email: contact@lasalleheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://lasalleheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: LaSalle, Windsor, Tecumseh, Amherstburg, Leamington, Lakeshore, Belle River, Essex. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
